notes: REL-SRC-001 directly supports the France implementation called musique and explicitly notes GB/IRE ordering difference; broader jurisdiction definitions remain follow-up work.

notes: REG-SRC-008 and REG-SRC-011 support North American Rabbit and France Galop tactical leader as regional implementations. Keep distinct from generic RUN-008 Pacesetter.
